title: z-ark Digivice showcase
baseline_note: This identifies the simulator source snapshot used for these samples. It is not a claim about the latest repository revision or a firmware identity inferred from camera footage.

hardware.label: Hardware footage
hardware.source: Two owner-supplied recordings of the actual device
observed: Partner browsing with Hagurumon and Kumamon
Hagurumon versus Tentomon in Auto battle
Successful automatic capture: NEW FRIEND! and PARTNER SAVED
limits: The recorded capture is automatic; it is not a manual flick demonstration.
These clips do not demonstrate a walking trial or a two-device radio exchange.
The footage itself does not identify its installed firmware commit.
processing: Tracked tight crop around the physical display and a narrow part of the red bezel.
Dark circular matte removes areas outside the selected display framing.
Real touching fingertips remain where they overlap the display.
Original-speed continuous playback, 30 fps; endpoint duration may round by up to one output frame.
SDR BT.709 source conversion retained. No generated imagery, screen replacement, or synthetic sharpening.
All audio, source capture metadata, chapters and identifying metadata removed. Only generic codec/container tags remain.

simulator.label: Simulator · native UI · seeded state
simulator.method: Fresh host rendering from an immutable snapshot of the sample firmware baseline, using its native C++ renderer and locally verified SD assets.
limits: Prepared game states, not recordings of human play.
Walking counters and encounter inputs are synthetic.
Nearby peers are injected and exchanges use the native local resolver; physical radio behavior is not demonstrated.
Replays hold exact rendered samples at their timeline intervals; they do not verify physical-device frame timing.
Trading and background music are not represented as installed in this sample baseline.

enclosure.label: Actual CAD · C14-P19 touch-only
enclosure.method: Exact frozen printed-part and reference-hardware meshes rendered in Blender Cycles. Presentation translations, materials and lighting only; no geometry changes or mirroring.
enclosure.colorway: Black rear and carrier, white front and RF window, red bezel and top roof
enclosure.electronics: Waveshare 1.46-inch integrated board/display, SKU 29565, using official reference meshes; blank display intentional
enclosure.battery: 36 × 67 × 10 mm design envelope; actual cell and connector fit unverified
enclosure.optional: NFC reader, antenna and plugs are separate reference envelopes; the optional reader tray is an actual printed-part mesh.
limits: Exploded separation is illustrative and is not an assembly order.
Nominal screw profiles are diagrams, not verified screw-head geometry.
Physical fit, printed dimensions and screw grip are unverified.

notices: Independent fan-made build; no affiliation or endorsement is claimed.
